topic: Day 124 — reel — The discipline to stop matters as much as the discipline to start
text:
Stopping takes
the same
[discipline]
as starting.
caption:
Discipline gets filed entirely under persistence. Knowing when to put something down is the same muscle, used in the harder direction.
